reviewed_by: Claude: harness gateway keeps project hook denial reasons
reason: HarnessRuntimeService._gateway_oci_call caught the broker's PolicyDenied (including ProjectHookPolicyDenied) and flattened it to {status: denied, detail}; _gateway_call then rebuilt a bare PermissionError, so tool_failure took its generic 'denied by an access or approval rule' branch and the hook's stderr, route_to and policy_rule never reached the harness model. The gateway now classifies the real exception with tool_failure (FAILURE_SCHEMA), which _gateway_call passes through unchanged. New tests drive _gateway_oci_call with a hook-denying broker (with and without route_to) and fail on origin/main.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_harnesses.py ran locally (141 passed, 2 failed); the 2 failures (test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog, test_browser_attachment_refreshes_catalog_without_replacing_native_thread) fail identically on origin/main 702cc77, so the file is not selected. No frontend, native or Playwright layer: the change is backend-only and adds no UI. No LAN real-Core harness journey was run: it needs a live vendor harness session.
